Arcade Survivor third-party UI art
==================================

OFDN UI Pack
------------
Files: OFDN/OFDN_InventoryA.png, OFDN_InventoryB1.png, OFDN_InventoryB2.png,
OFDN/OFDN_HealthA1.png, OFDN/OFDN_HealthA2.png
Title: Dark Fantasy UI Pack - Health bars, inventory containers, buttons
Author: Of Far Different Nature
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/dark-fantasy-ui-pack-health-bars-inventory-containers-buttons
License: CC BY 4.0
Changes: cropped/renamed files, used as Unity UI sprites and tinted at runtime.

Title: rusted metal texture pack

Changes: renamed, used as a UI backdrop and tinted at runtime.
